replies.body: Addressed in `supportsCustomAccessor` — the wrapper uses `new ExecutionException("wrapper", null)` so `getCause()` is null and the underlying error is reachable only via the custom accessor. See `CauseUnwrapperTest.supportsCustomAccessor`.
Renamed to `rootCause` in 604814f2c2 and updated the RuleParser call site + tests.
Renamed the 2-arg helper to `unwrap(error, predicate)` (delegates to the 3-arg overload) in 604814f2c2; updated all CauseUnwrapper call sites.

threads.body: [Style] Classes under `javaagent/src/main` are internal implementation details, and the project style guide explicitly says not to add `final` there (`docs/contributing/style-guide.md:99-104`). Please remove `final`.

[General] This explanation contradicts `@Advice.OnMethodEnter(..., inline = false)` above: Byte Buddy delegates this advice instead of inlining it. Please remove the comment or document the actual reason this helper is required, otherwise future changes may rely on an incorrect assumption about the transformed bytecode.

[General] This rationale is inaccurate because the calling advice is explicitly annotated with `inline = false`; its body is delegated rather than inlined into the instrumented method. Please remove this paragraph or replace it with the actual reason for keeping a separate helper.
